text:
matt.hm: FYI raised a comp-band exception for an incoming candidate. Hiring manager recommends promoting offer from IC4 to IC5 to match market. Proposed comp: base $225,000, target bonus 12%, RSU 0.4%.

zoe.recruiter: Candidate needs a decision quick 126 - they can start 5/3 if we move fast. Multiple offers from competitors.

tina.hr: Tagging comp-requests. Please include manager rationale, org impact, and whether hiring budget exists. @raj.pm can you add the short case?

raj.pm: Short case: Will lead cross-team infra stabilizations for low-latency routing; expected to cut p95 latency by 20% in Q3. Previous offers at IC4 were declined. Hiring buffer available in FY2026 plan. Recommend IC5 to secure candidate.

leo.finance: We have capacity in the hiring pool but policy requires director sign-off + finance acknowledgement + a documented 6-month checkpoint plan if promoting above band. cc @olivia.dir

olivia.dir: I'm comfortable approving to escalate to committee provided we attach measurable goals and a 6-month calibration review. I can sign off contingent on that.

comp-committee-bot: Request submitted. Routing: manager -> director -> finance -> comp-committee. Ticket CCQ-2026-1907. Standard SLA 72h; urgent flag set on request.

tina.hr: Candidate timeline is 24-36h. Two suggested paths: 1) request urgent committee review (ask chair for same-day) or 2) offer at IC4 top-of-band + sign-on equity refresh to bridge disparity. Thoughts?

matt.hm: Prefer IC5. Risk of losing candidate is high. If committee can't commit same-day, fallback to IC4+sign-on: $25k one-time equity refresh vesting over 2 years.

olivia.dir: I'll ping the committee chair for expedited review. Also OK to approve interim sign-on equity as a holding measure. Include clause that final comp may change pending committee decision.

tina.hr: Drafting hold offer language now. Draft clause: 

"Offer contingent on final comp-committee approval. If committee declines the band exception, candidate will receive the top of IC4 band plus a one-time equity refresh ($25,000 value) as a retention measure. Final compensation will be adjusted post-committee and documented in the employee record."

zoe.recruiter: I'll share the provisional offer and request candidate signs to lock start; make clear it's contingent on final approval. Will report back within 12h.

matt.hm: Thanks team 10 :thumbsup:
